title: Crunchy Ukrainian Chicken Wrap
description: A delicious and easy-to-make Ukrainian-inspired wrap filled with crispy chicken, crunchy vegetables, and a tangy sauce. Perfect for a quick snack or meal.

ingredients.name: vinaigrette
ingredients.notes: apple cider vinegar and olive oil

instructions: Preheat a large skillet over medium-high heat.
Add the chicken breast to the skillet and cook for 5-6 minutes per side, or until cooked through.
Let the chicken rest for a few minutes before slicing it thinly.
In a large bowl, combine the sauerkraut, diced carrots and celery, and sliced chicken.
In a small bowl, whisk together the vinaigrette and chicken seasoning.
Pour the dressing over the chicken mixture and toss to coat.
Warm the large flour tortilla in the microwave for 10-15 seconds.
Assemble the wrap by spooning the chicken mixture onto the tortilla and serving immediately.
